values: 一名在使用旋叶卡牌作战的游侠，会给队友派发任务来援助战斗。
A Rogue who wields throwing blades and assigns objectives to allies, unlocking battle bonuses when allies complete them.
I suppose even I have to work.
It's time to deal you in.
别介意，总会有这么一天的。
This feels like a bad hair day...
Are you ready? Because I am, darling.
要来陪我玩一把吗？随时恭候。
Care for a little game, darling? I'm wickedly good with my hands.
有点闷……啊，抱歉，没看到吧？
Let me show you a trick. Fabulous! Isn't it>
This thing gets a little tight... Oh, spying on me are we?
真是美丽，我喜欢你的品味。
高贵与低贱，神圣与罪恶，通常只是视角之差。
Ivory and gold, shadow and light—what is noble may be seen as sin.
仿佛有无数种凝视，一触即放，而他面具下的笑意始终如一。
They watch, they judge, they wait... but the smile behind the mask never changes.
Let's just enjoy ourselves for a while!
要是能开舞会就更妙了……
A ball would be perfect right about now...
So, what fun is there to be had?
沙利叶对于吃喝玩乐有着其他人难以比拟的热情与灵感。宴席的菜单与酒单，服饰的搭配，牌局的规则，舞会的舞步与配乐……去掉部分过于天马行空的内容之外，大部分都深受贵族们追捧。
Ravion is second to none when it comes to indulgence. Aside from some overly wild ideas, nobles love the food, drinks, costumes, games, dances, and music he prepares.
尽管身为女王亲子，但沙利叶几乎不在王宫留宿，大多时间都住在自己的某间豪华私宅中——事实上，沙利叶殿下到底有多少别馆，也一直是贵族圈子里津津乐道的话题。

Despite being the Queen's son, Ravion hardly ever spends the night at the palace, as he prefers to stay at one of his lavish private residences. The nobles delight in gossiping about exactly how many properties he owns.
沙利叶不认为自己额外偏爱平民，事实上，他只是对所有人一视同仁而已——但对大部分贵族来说，这就足够不可接受了。
Ravion never considers himself as favoring the commoners, because he simply treats everyone the same. However, many nobles find even that unacceptable.
沙利叶精通绝大部分武器，但他懒得拿这些累赘；所以他的护卫随行时通常都会多携带一把副武器——通常是剑或者匕首——供他使用；捎带一提，上一次带了流星锤的那位被席蕾斥责了三天，但沙利叶倒挺喜欢的。
Skilled with nearly every weapon, Ravion is too lazy to carry them. His guards bring spares—one even brought a meteor hammer. Xera fumed for days, but Ravion had a blast.
沙利叶对自己的外貌还挺满意的，唯独反感那些鳞片，因此他总是选择繁复的衣甲并佩戴面具尽可能地遮掩——至于为什么面具反而会刻意将鳞片露在外面，那自然是因为他想与其他人分享看到丑恶之物的这份不快。
Ravion is fairly pleased with his appearance, except for the scales on his body. To conceal them, he wears elaborate armor and a mask. Interestingly, the mask itself bears a scale-like motif.
在双方争斗最激烈的时候，奎茵曾脱口而出：“你以前就是一条畸形的爬虫！”；而沙利叶则反击：“所以你是说我母亲越长越像我小时候了？”——当时狂怒的奎茵差点拆了半座宫殿，直到奈萨雷斯不得不亲自调停。

During a heated clash, Velara hurled an insult at Ravion, "You used to be a deformed reptile!" He shot back, "So you're saying my mother's starting to look like my younger self?" Only Seralyth stopped her from leveling the palace.
沙利叶无所顾忌的幽默感一度让都铎忠心耿耿的部下们忍无可忍，但在第四次试图套麻袋围殴他的偷袭失败后，他们不得不承认：“这小子身手比想象得更灵活……肯定是将军教得好！”
Thador's loyal subordinates tried to beat Ravion for his sharp tongue, but gave up after four failed ambush attempts. "He's faster than we thought... must be the general's training."
与奈萨雷斯一样，沙利叶的体温比常人要高，而血更是如此，据说鲜血滴落时甚至有近乎沸腾的温度。
Just like Seralyth, Ravion has a higher body temperature than the average human. His blood is said to be nearly boiling when it drips.
自从沙利叶跻身三长老以来，他就始终是奎茵最大的阻碍者，但他堪称恶意的诸多行动却很少受到实质性的惩罚，这通常被认为女王对子嗣的宠信；而沙利叶自己对此则评价为：“舍不得杀的疯狗总得配条放心的狗链子。”
Velara's constant rival in the Three Exarchs, Ravion often escapes punishment—a sign, many say, of the Queen's indulgence. He calls himself "a mad dog with a leash too sturdy to break".
在沙利叶成年时，女王陛下将“旋叶”赐给他护身，据说那是某位贤者昔年为女王陛下亲自制作的应急武器，曾陪伴她度过漫长的时光——不过对热爱玩牌的沙利叶来说，把这玩意当牌打真是格外顺手。
When Ravion came of age, the Queen gifted him the Leaf-Fall, an emergency weapon made by a sage for Her Majesty. Ravion, a card game enthusiast, prefers to use it like a playing card.
这不是我的木头卫队长和他的得力助手嘛。
Well, if it isn't the strait-laced Captain Indris and his right-hand man!
沙利叶，我无意重复你那没有原则的风流引发的诸多舆论，也无意纠正你手下卫队的不洁与混乱。
Ravion, I'm not here to lecture you about your questionable private life, nor do I care to deal with your unruly guards.
难得见你空闲，愿意与我同赏这馥郁美景吗？
It's rare to find you unoccupied. Care to enjoy this stunning sight with me?
有趣，萨洛克兰的未来，我眼前也是一片迷雾呢。
Good question! Honestly, I think it's uncertain.
一国无主，群狼环伺，还有这无尽的公务和琐事……
Without a ruler, Sal'thorin is now vulnerable. I can't seem to get through my duties and all this trivial work...
我在萨洛克兰见过许多一直戴着面具的人，这是某种必要的社交礼仪吗？
I saw many people wearing masks in Sal'thorin. Is this observance a particular point of local etiquette?
向您致敬，尊敬的陛下，能见到您真是我的无上荣幸。
Your Majesty, it's my highest honor to be in your presence.
啊，真是麻烦……我讨厌工作。
Let's just enjoy ourselves for a while!
So, what fun is there to be had?
哦？又一位伟大的国王陛下，向您致以敬意。
Oh? Another great king in my presence. My deepest respects, Your Majesty.
